operations.request: Allocate an opaque unique ticket, immediately acquire or return queued; never wait for active guest body
operations.try_request: Immediate attempt; no enqueue, no wait on internal bookkeeping mutex; return EMPTY on contention
operations.release: Release owner and return next FIFO token, or cancel queued token; idempotent for stale same-gate tokens
operations.holds: Check active same-gate ownership before guest body; separately verify task and actor generation
operations.retire: Close gate, revoke owner and queued tickets after physical body quiescence; deny new admission

safety_invariants: No physical mutex spans guest execution or any await
No guest callback is executed by request/release/retire or under metadata synchronization
Cancellation versus owner release never admits a cancelled continuation
A token from a retired actor generation never resumes in the new incarnation
Cross-tenant/isolate capability checks are independent of token identity
Retirement must not interrupt an active mutation or claim transactional rollback
Queue timeout, cancellation and supervisor shutdown are scheduler responsibilities
No compiler may admit critical source until scoped guard and transitive no-suspension checks are implemented
